name: Audio Transcribe
description: Record from the mic OR drag/drop many local audio files (including WhatsApp .opus voice notes), then transcribe each to text using curated OpenRouter audio models — entirely in your browser. Batch queue with per-row status and retry, bundle the session's audio and/or transcripts into a .zip, and optionally send an encrypted share via SG/Send.

api.note: Live after tool:ready. In-memory queue of audio items; the OpenRouter key is persisted (localStorage 'sg-openrouter-mgmt-key'), but no audio/transcripts are persisted. Transcription uses the chat input_audio path via sg-llm-request (no dedicated STT endpoint in v1). WhatsApp .opus voice notes are the #1 use case: a three-tier never-fail format strategy (pass-through → native decodeAudioData → WASM Opus decode via core/sg-audio-decode) converts undecodable audio to WAV on every browser including Safari; the decoder WASM is persisted in the Cache API (core/sg-wasm-cache, version-keyed) so it downloads once. JSZip is lazy-loaded from CDN only when downloadZip/sendViaSgSend is invoked. Send uses the embedded <sg-send-drop> component and requires a live send.sgraph.ai API + access token.

startRecording.description: Begin a single-take mic recording via core/sg-audio. Emits at:recording:started.

stopRecording.description: Stop the recording, assemble one blob, add it as a queue item. Emits at:recording:stopped + at:item:added.

addFiles.description: Batch ingest. Add every audio file (incl. .opus) as a queue item; rejects non-audio ({code:'not-audio'}) and oversize ({code:'too-large'}) per file. Accepts {files} (File[]/FileList). Emits at:item:added per accepted file.

loadSample.description: Load a built-in sample audio as a queue item (simulates a drop). Params {id} from getSamples/SAMPLES; tone samples are synthesised in-browser.

getItems.description: Serialisable snapshot of the whole queue (no Blob): id, name, sizeBytes, mimeType, durationMs, origin, model, status, transcript?.

getItem.description: One item (serialisable) by id, or null.

removeItem.description: Drop one item by id. Emits at:item:removed.

clearAll.description: Clear the whole queue + session. Emits at:reset.

getReleases.description: The tool's changelog, newest first: [{version,date,summary,changes[]}]. Same data shown in the dev panel's Releases tab.

setModel.description: Set the active model for new items (or, with id, one item's model). Emits at:model:changed.

connect.description: Fire llm:connected {provider:'openrouter', model, apiKey} so sg-llm-request can send. apiKey is masked in the dev console.

transcribeItem.description: Transcribe one queue item: blob → supported format/data URL → binary_file message → llm:send → resolve. Sets status/transcript. Used for retry too. Emits at:transcribe:started/complete/error (each carries {id}).

transcribeAll.description: Transcribe every queued/error item strictly serially (concurrency 1 — the shared LLM bus transport is single-flight). Emits at:batch:started, at:batch:progress {done,total}, at:batch:complete.

transcribe.description: Alias/convenience for transcribeAll; if exactly one item exists it behaves like transcribeItem on that row.

getTranscript.description: One item's transcript (with id) or all transcripts (without id).

downloadZip.description: Build a .zip from the session (or an items subset) per include:{audio?,transcripts?} flags, plus manifest.json + index.txt, and trigger a browser download. Default include: {audio:false, transcripts:true}. Emits at:bundle:created.

sendViaSgSend.description: Build the same bundle and hand it to the embedded <sg-send-drop> via offerFile; resolve on sg-send-complete with {shareUrl, token}. Surfaces {code:'send-auth-required'} when no token. Requires a live send.sgraph.ai. Emits at:send:started/complete/error.
